This candidate closes the real long-video picker/camera limit for POST-PICKER-CAMERA and reduces the media negative-state limit with shared failure, unsupported and cancelled outcomes. Web/Wasm serves a versioned MP4 fixture from the local evidence server, Android copies the same MP4 into the app sandbox for instrumentation, and iOS drives the simulator fixture path through the Mac VM runner.

The product exposes a common composer media error state anchored as composer-media.error. Failure and unsupported outcomes surface that shared error on Web/Wasm, Android and iOS; cancelled outcomes leave the composer unchanged with no media error.
The flow uses existing common composer actions and selected media preview anchors. The media file is local-only and the evidence does not mutate backend data.
